ticks.note: Tick 1 enters A; its transition is delayed. I = 1.
The self-loop reads I (seen = 1) and writes I = 11. A chart may assign to its own inputs.
No new value is supplied, so I keeps the value the chart wrote: seen = 11, I = 21. Persistence carries forward whatever the input held at the end of the last tick.
A supplied value overwrites the chart's write before the tick runs: seen = 7, I = 17.
seen = 17, and the chart writes I = 27.
